newsitem.title: USA: Discovery West says board oks Magin bid.
newsitem.headline: Discovery West says board oks Magin bid.

text.p: Discovery West Corp said Tuesday its board of directors has recommended shareholders accept the take-over bid by Magin Energy Ltd.
The company said Rayrock Yellowknife Resources Inc, which holds 38.9 percent of the shares of Discovery West, has agreed to the offer.
The company said Magin's previously-announced bid offers shareholders the choice of Canadian $2.56 in cash or C$0.98 of a common share of Magin for every Discovery share tendered.
The company said the most Magin will pay for the offer is limited to C$34 million cash and a maximum of 20.5 million shares.
The company said the offer is open until April 30.
